matchup_context: when team is losing or has poor teamfight
insight: Split push and farm alternative lanes while enemies 5-man siege. Force enemy rotations, then teleport back to fight. This is more effective than sitting in base defending when your team lacks initiation.
Cut creep waves in side lanes after enemies take tier 2. Hide in treelines while watching minimap. When enemies rotate, farm jungle camps. Place observer wards to spot teleports coming in.
Stay in treelines at the edge of enemy vision. Do not move unnecessarily or use abilities that reveal position. Only engage when you have a kill opportunity or defensive advantage.

Farming multiple lanes while enemies 5-man in one location matches their farm output. Farming mid alone equals their entire team's farming rate. Prioritize getting gold for key items rather than early defense.
Use Glimmer Cape before blinking away from threats rather than standing in creep waves. Walk in with Glimmer active, then blink out.
Wait for core power spikes (items like Aghanim's Scepter) before committing to fights. Delaying split push by 20-30 seconds for better item timing can secure kills and shift advantage.
If you don't trust teammates to split push or farm, you must do it yourself. Split pushing is more important in these games because someone needs to create pressure and punish enemy rotations.
Trade time for objectives. Accept losing a tier 3 tower to buy your team 1-3 minutes while you farm other lanes. This creates space for core items to complete.
Place observer wards in the lane where you're split pushing to spot enemy teleports and rotations coming in. Allows you to glimmer/blink away before being caught.
Use ultimate to threaten and take towers/barracks while split pushing, not just to defend. Combines split push pressure with real objective value.

If you lack long-range abilities (Keeper of the Light, Warlock, Venomancer), you shouldn't be the one defending high ground. Let cores with better siege capabilities defend while you split push instead.
Don't teleport home immediately when enemies start pushing. Wait to see if they commit fully, then teleport when a core is ready or when they're about to take a critical objective.
Target side lanes with tier 1 destroyed for easiest creep cutting. Alternate between cutting waves and farming jungle camps in between.
Use map awareness to recognize safe windows to split push. Scout with wards, watch minimap, and retreat when enemies have TP advantage or appear on map heading toward you.
